import { RouteActionIconScope } from "@/components/shell/action-icon-route-scope";
import { MobileTopBar } from "@/components/shell/mobile-top-bar";
import { NavTrail } from "@/components/shell/nav-trail";
import { PullToSearch } from "@/components/shell/pull-to-search";
import { Sidebar } from "@/components/shell/sidebar";
import { CommandPalette } from "@/components/shell/command-palette";
import { AssistantLauncher } from "@/components/assistant/assistant-launcher";
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { Suspense } from "react";
import { PermissionsProvider } from "@/components/permissions-provider";
import { VocabularyProvider } from "@/components/vocabulary-provider";
import { getLocale, getT } from "@/i18n";
import { I18nProvider } from "@/i18n/client";
import { readableAreas, requireSession, writableAreas } from "@/lib/session";
import { listActiveProfessionNames } from "@/queries/professions";
import { isApplePlatform } from "@/lib/keyboard";

export default async function AppLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  // Temp passwords are single-use: requireSession sends a session that
  // still carries one to /password, here and in every page, query, action
  // and route (audit W-M4) — the layout is not the boundary.
  const session = await requireSession();
  // getT carries the DB profession-label overlay — the client dict too.
  const [dict, locale] = await Promise.all([getT(), getLocale()]);
  const professionVocabulary = await listActiveProfessionNames();
  // What the UI may OFFER this session (2026-08-28). Not a boundary — the
  // actions still check — but it is what keeps a read-only account from
  // clicking its way into an error page.
  const grants = await writableAreas();
  // And what it may read — the navigation hides a closed record (spec
  // 2026-09-30-read-permissions). The pages themselves are the guard.
  const readable = await readableAreas();
  const initialIsMac = isApplePlatform((await headers()).get("user-agent") ?? "");

  return (
    <I18nProvider dict={dict} locale={locale}>
      <PermissionsProvider areas={grants.areas} readable={readable} adminTools={grants.adminTools}>
      <VocabularyProvider professions={professionVocabulary}>
      <div className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col lg:flex-row">
        <Sidebar userName={session.user.name} userEmail={session.user.email} initialIsMac={initialIsMac} />
        <MobileTopBar
          userName={session.user.name}
          userEmail={session.user.email}
        />
        <main className="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
          {/* Phones: dragging the page down from its top opens the search —
              the content carries [data-pull-content] so the gesture can
              move it, and the pill below rides in the gap it opens. */}
          <PullToSearch />
          {/* Pages that render a [data-page-full-width] marker (the
              Operations dispatch desk) escape the reading-width cap — the
              spec wants the board full-width; everything else stays 5xl. */}
          {/* pb-24 below sm: clearance for the assistant launcher, which
              otherwise floats exactly over the BottomActions primary button
              and the last rows of lists on phones. */}
          {/* Phones get a tighter rhythm (gap-4): a list page stacks header,
              actions, toolbar and summary before its first row, and at
              gap-6 that first row started halfway down a 375px screen. */}
          <div data-pull-content className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col gap-4 px-4 py-5 pb-24 sm:gap-6 sm:px-8 sm:py-8 has-[[data-page-full-width]]:max-w-none">
            <RouteActionIconScope>{children}</RouteActionIconScope>
          </div>
        </main>
        <AssistantLauncher />
        <CommandPalette />
        {/* Records where you came from, so back links can return there
            (useSearchParams needs the Suspense boundary). */}
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <NavTrail />
        </Suspense>
      </div>
      </VocabularyProvider>
      </PermissionsProvider>
    </I18nProvider>
  );
}
